diagnosis.note: Traces the causes of the problem based on the last simulation result. After fixing, run the next epoch to refresh.

noProblem.title: No problems found
noProblem.description: There is nothing to report for this agent right now.

cycle.title: Circular cause
cycle.description: This facility is already being diagnosed further up (mutual dependency).

depth_limit.title: Stopped digging deeper
depth_limit.description: The chain of causes is too long. Diagnose the facility directly.

no_alert.title: This facility itself reports no problem
no_alert.description: Its output may simply be limited by its size or utilization target.

facility_inactive.title: Facility is not operating
facility_inactive.description: It is under construction, paused, or collapsed. Check the facility details.

material_shortage.title: Cannot procure raw materials
material_shortage.description: Some required materials did not arrive, so production fell short of plan.

material_unmet_unknown.title: Could not identify the missing material
material_unmet_unknown.description: This can happen right after demand shrinks. Check the next epoch's result.

infra_no_terminal.title: No connection terminal
infra_no_terminal.description: This facility has no terminal node for {{product_name}}.

infra_terminal_unconnected.title: No path reaches the connection terminal
infra_terminal_unconnected.description: Run a path that can carry {{product_name}} to the facility's terminal.

infra_link_not_active.title: Feeder path is not active yet
infra_link_not_active.description: {{count}} path(s) reaching the terminal are under construction or not started. Supply begins when they complete.

infra_link_incompatible.title: Feeder path cannot carry {{product_name}}
infra_link_incompatible.description: The path reaching the terminal is of a type that cannot carry this good (e.g. non-electrified track). Rebuild it as a compatible type or add a separate feeder.

infra_no_producer.title: No {{product_name}} producer in the city
infra_no_producer.description: Build a producer (e.g. a power plant) and connect it to the network.

infra_producers_inactive.title: {{product_name}} producers are not operating
infra_producers_inactive.description: None of the {{count}} producers in the city is active.

infra_producers_unconnected.title: Producers are not connected to the network
infra_producers_unconnected.description: {{count}} producer(s) are active but none is connected to the {{product_name}} network.

infra_network_split.title: This network has no producer
infra_network_split.description: The {{product_name}} producers ({{producers}}) are on a different network. The two networks are broken apart or were never joined.

infra_link_under_construction.title: A connecting path is under construction
infra_link_under_construction.description: {{count}} path(s) that will join this network are pending. They may link it to the producers' network once complete.

infra_gap_detected.title: The network is broken here
infra_gap_detected.description: The two networks' endpoints are only {{distance}} m apart. Join these points with a path that carries {{product_name}}, or merge the endpoints.

infra_tap_missing.title: Not tapped into the producers' network
infra_tap_missing.description: Run a path that carries {{product_name}} (e.g. a power line) from the producers' network and tap it into this one.

infra_generation_shortage.title: Not enough {{product_name}} is produced
infra_generation_shortage.description: This network produces {{supply}} against a demand of {{demand}} ({{producers}} producer(s)). Add or expand producers.

infra_transmission_bottleneck.title: Network capacity is saturated
infra_transmission_bottleneck.description: {{count}} path(s) are running at full capacity. Add parallel paths or rebuild them as a higher-capacity type.

infra_unexplained.title: The network looks healthy
infra_unexplained.description: Production and connectivity are sufficient, so the shortage may have been transient. Check the next epoch's result.

market_no_supplier.title: No supplier of {{product_name}} in the city
market_no_supplier.description: There is no active domestic producer and no import. Attract a producer or set up an import hub.

market_supply_insufficient.title: Supply of {{product_name}} falls short of demand
market_supply_insufficient.description: Supply {{supply}} against city-wide orders of {{demand}} ({{producers}} producer(s), {{hubs}} import hub(s)).

market_unmatched.title: Could not procure {{product_name}} on the market
market_unmatched.description: City-wide supply {{supply}} covers orders of {{demand}}, but it did not reach this facility. Distance, price, or service range may be the cause.

high_skill_shortage.title: Cannot secure skilled staff
high_skill_shortage.description: The minimum number of high-skill workers is not met, so the production plan is zero. High-skill workers are trained at universities: build one and allocate its admission quotas to the required skill.

labor_market_tight.title: No workers left in the city
labor_market_tight.description: Unemployment is only {{unemployment_rate}}%, so nobody is available to hire. Add housing to attract residents.

labor_unfilled.title: Job seekers exist but do not come
labor_unfilled.description: Unemployment is {{unemployment_rate}}%. Long commutes, low wages, or a skill mismatch are likely.

budget_capped.title: Budget is insufficient
budget_capped.description: The allocated budget is far below what is required. Review the budget allocation.

line_paused_route_disconnected.title: Route between stops is broken
line_paused_route_disconnected.description: Consecutive stops in the loop are not connected by track or street that can be traveled in the needed direction. Rebuild the broken section or revise the route. To turn back on one-way tracks, turn back at a station on track that runs both ways (such as a double track laid as a single path), or let trains move to the opposite track by joining the tracks at a single node or laying a crossover, and place the return stops on the platforms for the opposite direction.

line_paused_no_underlay.title: Stop has no underlying path
line_paused_no_underlay.description: The track or street the stop was on no longer exists.

line_paused_train_too_long.title: Train is longer than its stop's section
line_paused_train_too_long.description: Reduce cars per train or extend the section the stop is on (a station platform, or a street or track section).

line_no_vehicle_product.title: This line type has no vehicle defined

line_off_network.title: Line is not on a running network
line_off_network.description: The line's route is not linked to any track or street.

transit_no_depot.title: No {{product_name}} depot in the city
transit_no_depot.description: Build a depot and connect it to the running network.

transit_depots_inactive.title: Depots are not operating
transit_depots_inactive.description: None of the {{count}} depots in the city is active.

transit_depots_unconnected.title: Depots are not connected to the running network
transit_depots_unconnected.description: None of the {{count}} depots is linked to track or street. For rail, lay a siding from the main line to the depot's terminal.

transit_depot_other_network.title: Depots are on a different network
transit_depot_other_network.description: {{count}} depot(s) are connected to a track network that does not reach this line. Link the networks or build a depot on this one.

transit_vehicle_insufficient.title: Not enough vehicles are produced
transit_vehicle_insufficient.description: Depots on this network ({{depots}}) supply {{supply}} cars against {{demand}} required by the lines.

transit_unexplained.title: Depots look healthy
transit_unexplained.description: Supply and connectivity are sufficient, so the shortage may have been transient. Check the next epoch's result.
